about: Words the copy does not gloss (the Gītā Dhyānam, the speakers' lines, the colophons), that its glosses place wrongly, or that a check against the Sanskrit found imprecise (reasons under why): ours, from Monier-Williams and Apte; and under force the long compounds whose pairing with the copy's glosses is right though its sounds score low (checked by eye).

p: श्रीभगवान्, ऐश्वर्य आदि छहों गुणोंसे सम्पन्न प्रभु

धृतराष्ट्र.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (धृतराष्ट्रः; उवाचसे पहले विसर्गका लोप)

सञ्जय.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (सञ्जयः; उवाचसे पहले विसर्गका लोप) / सम्बोधन एकवचन

अर्जुन.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (अर्जुनः; उवाचसे पहले विसर्गका लोप) / सम्बोधन एकवचन

श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु.en: in the Upaniṣads of the Śrīmad Bhagavad Gītā

श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे.en: in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna

अर्जुनविषादयोगो.en: Arjunaviṣādayoga, the yoga of Arjuna’s despondency
अर्जुनविषादयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

साङ्ख्ययोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

कर्मयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

ज्ञानकर्मसंन्यासयोगो.en: Jñānakarmasaṃnyāsayoga, the yoga of knowledge and the renunciation of action
ज्ञानकर्मसंन्यासयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

संन्यासयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

आत्मसंयमयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगो.en: Jñānavijñānayoga, the yoga of knowledge and realised knowledge
ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

अक्षरब्रह्मयोगो.en: Akṣarabrahmayoga, the yoga of the imperishable Brahman
अक्षरब्रह्मयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

राजविद्याराजगुह्ययोगो.en: Rājavidyārājaguhyayoga, the yoga of the sovereign knowledge and the sovereign secret
राजविद्याराजगुह्ययोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

विभूतियोगो.en: Vibhūtiyoga, the yoga of the divine manifestations
विभूतियोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

विश्वरूपदर्शनयोगो.en: Viśvarūpadarśanayoga, the yoga of the vision of the universal form
विश्वरूपदर्शनयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

भक्तियोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञविभागयोगो.en: Kṣetrakṣetrajñavibhāgayoga, the yoga of the distinction between the field and its knower
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञविभागयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

गुणत्रयविभागयोगो.en: Guṇatrayavibhāgayoga, the yoga of the division of the three guṇas
गुणत्रयविभागयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

पुरुषोत्तमयोगो.en: Puruṣottamayoga, the yoga of the Supreme Person
पुरुषोत्तमयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

दैवासुरसम्पद्विभागयोगो.en: Daivāsurasampadvibhāgayoga, the yoga of the division between the divine and the demonic endowments
दैवासुरसम्पद्विभागयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

श्रद्धात्रयविभागयोगो.en: Śraddhātrayavibhāgayoga, the yoga of the threefold division of faith
श्रद्धात्रयविभागयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

मोक्षसंन्यासयोगो.en: Mokṣasaṃnyāsayoga, the yoga of liberation through renunciation
मोक्षसंन्यासयोगो.g: प्रथमा एकवचन (योगः; नामसे पहले सन्धिसे योगो)

अद्वैतामृतवर्षिणीं.en: who showers the nectar of non-duality

अश्वत्थामविकर्णघोरमकरा.hi: अश्वत्थामा और विकर्ण जिसके भयंकर मगर थे
अश्वत्थामविकर्णघोरमकरा.en: whose fearsome sea-monsters were Aśvatthāmā and Vikarṇa

कंसचाणूरमर्दनम्.en: the crusher of Kaṃsa and Cāṇūra

गीतामृतदुहे.en: to him who milks the nectar of the Gītā

गीतार्थगन्धोत्कटं.en: rich with the fragrance of the Gītā’s meaning

ज्ञानमुद्राय.en: to him who shows the gesture of knowledge

तोत्रवेत्रैकपाणये.hi: जिनके एक हाथमें पैना (पशु हाँकनेका) और बेंत है, उनको
तोत्रवेत्रैकपाणये.en: to him who holds the goad and the cane in one hand

त्वामनुसन्दधामि.en: you; I meditate on again and again

ध्यानावस्थिततद्गतेन.hi: ध्यानमें स्थित और उन्हींमें लगे हुए (मनसे)
ध्यानावस्थिततद्गतेन.en: fixed in meditation and absorbed in him

पाण्डवै.g: तृतीया बहुवचन (पाण्डवैः; रसे पहले विसर्गका लोप)

प्रतिबोधितां.g: णिजन्त क्त प्रत्यय, द्वितीया एकवचन, स्त्रीलिंग

प्रपन्नपारिजाताय.en: to him who is the wish-fulfilling pārijāta tree for those who take refuge

फुल्लारविन्दायतपत्रनेत्रे.hi: खिले हुए कमलकी पंखुड़ियोंके समान बड़े नेत्रोंवाले!
फुल्लारविन्दायतपत्रनेत्रे.en: with eyes long as the petals of a full-blown lotus

भगवतीमष्टादशाध्यायिनीं.en: the blessed one of eighteen adhyāyas

भारततैलपूर्णः.en: filled with the oil of the Mahābhārata

भीष्मद्रोणतटा.hi: भीष्म और द्रोण जिसके तट थे
भीष्मद्रोणतटा.en: whose banks were Bhīṣma and Droṇa

भूयाद्भारतपङ्कजं.en: may (it) be; the lotus of the Mahābhārata

वरुणेन्द्ररुद्रमरुतः.en: Varuṇa, Indra, Rudra and the Maruts

सज्जनषट्पदैरहरहः.en: by the good, as by bees; day after day

साङ्गपदक्रमोपनिषदैर्गायन्ति.hi: अंग, पद, क्रम और उपनिषदोंसहित; गाते हैं
साङ्गपदक्रमोपनिषदैर्गायन्ति.en: with their limbs, pada and krama recitations and Upaniṣads; sing

सुधीर्भोक्ता.en: the wise; the one who drinks

सुरासुरगणा.en: the hosts of gods and asuras

हरिकथासम्बोधनाबोधितम्.en: opened by the telling of Hari’s story

प्रणश्यामि.en: pass out of sight, am lost (to him)
प्रणश्यामि.g: प्र + नश्, लट्, उत्तम पुरुष एकवचन

प्रणश्यति.hi: ओझल होता है / नष्ट होता है
प्रणश्यति.en: passes out of sight, is lost / perishes
प्रणश्यति.g: प्र + नश्, लट्, प्रथम पुरुष एकवचन

पुण्यकर्मणाम्.en: of those whose deeds are virtuous

युज्यते.hi: युक्त हो जाता है / प्रयुक्त होता है
युज्यते.en: is united / is applied, is used

पितॄनथ.en: fathers, elders of the father's rank; then, and

अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन.hi: अनार्यों, हीन पुरुषोंद्वारा अपनाया गया; स्वर्ग न देनेवाला; अपयश करनेवाला; हे अर्जुन!
अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन.en: practised by the ignoble; not leading to heaven; causing disgrace; O Arjuna

कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा.en: the cause of the fruit of action; be; not

समाधौ.hi: समाधिमें, अन्तःकरणमें (जिसमें चित्तका समाधान होता है)
समाधौ.en: in samādhi, in the mind (where thought is composed)

समाधावचला.hi: समाधिमें, आत्मामें (जिसमें चित्त समाहित होता है); अचल, स्थिर
समाधावचला.en: in samādhi, in the Self (in which the mind is composed); immovable, steady

गुणकर्मसु.en: in the actions of the guṇas

पुरोवाच.en: of old, in the beginning (of creation); said

देवान्भावयतानेन.en: the gods; nourish (you all); with this

कामकामी.en: one who longs for the objects of desire

प्रजहि.hi: मार डालो (प्र+हन्) / त्याग दो (प्र+हा: प्रजहिहि, आगेके ह्ये- सहित)
प्रजहि.en: slay (pra-√han) / cast off (pra-√hā: prajahihi, with the hi- of hy enam)

ह्येनं.hi: अवश्य; इसको / क्योंकि; इसको / (प्रजहिहि का) हि; इसको
ह्येनं.en: indeed; this / for, indeed; this / (the hi of prajahihi); this

संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना.en: having steadied; oneself; by one's own mind

भजाम्यहम्.hi: अनुग्रह करता हूँ, अपनाता हूँ; मैं

युक्ताहारविहारस्य.en: of one moderate in food and in moving about

धातारमचिन्त्यरूप.hi: विधान और धारण करनेवालेको; अचिन्त्य रूपवालेको
धातारमचिन्त्यरूप.en: the ordainer, the sustainer; of inconceivable form

मश्नन्ति.en: enjoy (aśnanti; the m at the start ends surendralokam)

सुरेन्द्रलोक.en: the world of the lord of the gods (Indra)

भावेषु.en: in things, in forms of being

सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च.hi: सबका हरण करनेवाली; और; मैं; उत्पत्ति, उत्कर्ष; और
सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च.en: that seizes all; and; I; the origin, the rise; and

यादसामहम्.en: among the dwellers of the waters; I

ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे.en: of Brahmā; even; to the first creator

वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न.en: by the study of the Vedas and of sacrifices; not

कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे.en: in the producing of effect and cause

निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्.hi: निर्मल होनेसे; प्रकाश करनेवाला; निरामय, उपद्रवसे रहित
निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्.en: because of stainlessness; illuminating; free from ill

धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः.en: wise, steadfast; equal in blame and praise of himself

तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्.hi: तृष्णा और आसक्तिका उद्गम / तृष्णा और आसक्तिसे उत्पन्न
तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्.en: the source of craving and attachment / arising from craving and attachment

सम्प्रतिष्ठा.hi: स्थिति, बने रहना (आदि और अन्तके बीच)

सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः.hi: अन्तःकरणकी पूर्ण शुद्धि; ज्ञान और योगमें दृढ़ स्थिति
सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः.en: complete purity of the mind (sattva); steadfastness in knowledge and in yoga

अपरस्परसम्भूतं.hi: स्त्री-पुरुषके परस्पर संयोगसे उत्पन्न / एक-दूसरेसे उत्पन्न नहीं
अपरस्परसम्भूतं.en: born of the union of man and woman / not produced one by the other

नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः.en: ruined in mind; of little understanding

कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः.hi: चरपरे, खट्टे, नमकीन, बहुत गरम, तीखे, रूखे और दाहकारक
कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः.en: pungent, sour, salty, very hot, sharp, dry and burning

सद्भावे.en: in the sense of existence, reality

नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः.hi: दूसरोंकी जीविका नष्ट करनेवाला, कपटी; आलसी
नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः.en: ruinous to others' livelihood, dishonest; lazy

why.श्रीभगवानुवाच: the Hindi as our meanings open the Lord's speech (श्रीभगवान्‌ने कहा); English "the Lord", style.md
why.प्रणश्यामि: first person (अहं … न प्रणश्यामि, 6.30): the gloss copied प्रणश्यति's third person; "I do not pass out of his sight" (Śaṅkara)
why.प्रणश्यति: 6.30 (स च मे न प्रणश्यति): a finite verb, so होता है
why.पुण्यकर्मणाम्: a bahuvrīhi qualifying जनानाम् (7.28) and the people of the worlds (18.71): those whose deeds are virtuous, not the deeds
why.युज्यते: 17.26: सच्छब्दः … युज्यते repeats प्रयुज्यते of the line before, "is used, applied" of a word; जोड़ा जाता है ("is joined") misses it
why.गोपालनन्दनः: nandana m. 'a son' (MW); the Hindi gave 'giving joy to the cowherds' while the English gave 'son'; gopāla is one cowherd (Nanda)
why.वेलाकुला: velā 'tide, flow, current' (Apte) beside 'shore'; with Kṛpa as the current, the river's tide is meant; 'shore surging' mixed the two
why.तोत्रवेत्रैकपाणये: tottra: a goad for driving cattle (MW), पैना; अंकुश is the elephant-hook; vetra a cane, बेंत
why.पितॄनथ: the Hindi ran two glosses together (पिताओं पितृतुल्योंको); Arjuna's father was dead, so the plural is the father's generation
why.अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन: an-ārya-juṣṭa: 'practised or observed by non-Āryas' (MW); juṣṭa 'practised, resorted to' (Apte, citing Bg. 2.2): not 'not practised by the noble'
why.कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा: a tatpuruṣa, the cause (hetu, MW) of the fruit of action (Śaṅkara), as our meaning reads; 'motivated by' is the bahuvrīhi of 2.49 phalahetavaḥ
why.आत्मवान्: ātmavat: 'self-possessed, composed, prudent' (MW; Apte citing Bg. 2.45); Śaṅkara apramatta; not 'possessed of the Self'
why.समाधौ: samādhi from sam-ā-√dhā, the place in which the mind is composed (samādhīyate asmin): Śaṅkara reads the antaḥkaraṇa, as our meaning does
why.समाधावचला: Śaṅkara: samādhīyate cittam asminn iti samādhir ātmā, as our meaning reads
why.विधीयते: passive of vi-√dhā 'to make, form, produce' (MW, Apte); Śaṅkara: does not arise
why.गुणकर्मसु: a tatpuruṣa, guṇānāṃ karmasu (Śaṅkara), as the English and our meaning read; the Hindi gave a dvandva
why.पुरोवाच: purā 'formerly, of old' and 'at first, in the beginning' (MW); in 3.10 the beginning of creation (Śaṅkara sargādau)
why.देवान्भावयतानेन: causative of √bhū, 'cherish, foster' (MW bhāvita), Śaṅkara vardhayata: पुष्ट करो, as the English 'nourish'
why.भावयन्तु: as भावयत: causative of √bhū, foster (MW bhāvita)
why.भावयन्तः: as भावयत: causative of √bhū, foster (MW bhāvita)
why.कामकामी: kāma is also the object of desire (MW); Śaṅkara: kāmāḥ viṣayāḥ
why.प्रजहि: jahi is the imperative of √han, jahihi that of √hā; Śaṅkara splits prajahihi enam (cast off), as our meaning of 3.41 reads
why.ह्येनं: enam is accusative (इसको); in 3.41 Śaṅkara reads prajahihi enam, the hi closing the verb
why.विकर्मणः: vikarman: 'an unlawful or prohibited act' (Apte, citing Bg. 4.17; MW); Śaṅkara pratiṣiddhasya
why.संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना: Śaṅkara: ātmānaṃ svenaiva ātmanā saṃskṛtena manasā; ātman also 'the mind' (MW); not the supreme Self, as our meaning reads
why.भजाम्यहम्: √bhaj 'to declare for, prefer, choose' (MW); Śaṅkara anugṛhṇāmi; Hindi भजता हूँ reads as the Lord worshipping
why.विजितात्मा: ātman also 'the body' (MW); in 5.7 the mind is in viśuddhātmā and the senses in jitendriyaḥ, so Śaṅkara vijitadehaḥ
why.सर्गो: sarga 'creation', 'begetting, procreation' (MW); Śaṅkara on 5.19: sargo janma
why.अयतिः: a-yati, no striver (yati from √yat, MW 'no ascetic, Bhag.'); Śaṅkara prayatnavarjitaḥ, beside yatamāna (6.45)
why.दुर्लभतरं: a single word: the hi of 6.42 is in एतद्धि
why.एतद्धि: etat + hi: the hi was glossed under दुर्लभतरं
why.कर्मसंज्ञितः: saṃjñita 'called, named' (MW, Apte): an adjective, not a verb
why.धातारमचिन्त्यरूप: dhātṛ 'supporter, orderer, arranger' (MW); Śaṅkara: the dispenser of all fruits, as our meaning reads
why.प्रयाणकाले: prayāṇa 'departure, death' (MW); the Hindi ran प्रयाण into मृत्युके समय, and the two senses were one
why.मश्नन्ति: the printed line breaks inside surendralokam aśnanti: the verb is aśnanti (√aś, eat, enjoy)
why.सुरेन्द्रलोक: accusative (surendralokam), object of āsādya (9.20); its m is printed at the start of the next line
why.प्रतिजानीहि: prati-√jñā 'to promise, declare solemnly, affirm' (MW, Apte); Śaṅkara pratijñāṃ kuru, as our meaning reads
why.भावेषु: bhāva 'that which is or exists, thing, being' (MW); Śaṅkara vastuṣu
why.सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च: udbhava 'origin' and 'springing, growing' (MW); Śaṅkara utkarṣa, abhyudaya, as our meaning reads
why.यादसामहम्: yādas 'any large aquatic animal' (MW; Apte citing Bg. 10.29), as our meaning reads
why.ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे: brahmaṇaḥ is genitive with ādikartre (Śaṅkara: hiraṇyagarbhasya api ādikartā), as our meaning reads
why.वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न: veda-yajña + adhyayana: study of the Vedas and of the rites (Śaṅkara), not three means
why.कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे: the printed word has kāraṇa, cause, not karaṇa, instrument
why.उदासीनो: udāsīna 'sitting apart, neutral, one who is neither friend nor foe' (MW, Apte); Hindi उदासीन now reads as sad
why.निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्: anāmaya 'free from disease, healthy, sound' (MW, Apte); Śaṅkara nirupadrava; विकाररहित is not a sense
why.धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः: dhīra is both 'intelligent, wise' and 'steady, firm' (MW); Śaṅkara dhīmān
why.तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्: samudbhava ifc. is 'arisen from' or 'being the source of' (MW); Śaṅkara and our meaning read the latter
why.सम्प्रतिष्ठा: sampratiṣṭhā 'permanence, continuance (as opp. to beginning or end), Bhag.' (MW), beside ādi and anta
why.सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः: Śaṅkara reads jñānayoga as a dvandva, knowledge and yoga, as our meaning does
why.अपरस्परसम्भूतं: MW a-paraspara-sambhūta 'not produced one by the other, Bhag.'; Apte gives the reading 'produced by the union of male and female' (Śaṅkara), which our meaning follows
why.नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः: naṣṭātman 'deprived of mind or sense' (MW); the Self is not destroyed
why.भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं: lolupa 'very desirous, ardently longing for' (MW, Apte): craving, as our meaning reads
why.कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः: kaṭu is the pungent rasa (MW; Apte citing Bg. 17.9), not tikta, bitter; tīkṣṇa 'sharp' (MW, Apte)
why.सद्भावे: sadbhāva 'real being, existence' (MW); the Hindi ran two glosses together
why.यातयामं: yātayāma 'used, spoiled' and 'raw, half-ripe' (MW); Śaṅkara mandapakva, as our meaning reads
why.कुशले: kuśala 'right, proper, good, auspicious' (Apte, citing Bg. 18.10); the Hindi was garbled
why.द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं: akuśala 'inauspicious, evil' (MW, Apte); 'disagreeable' is not a sense
why.सत्त्वं: sattva 'being, entity' and 'a living being, creature' (MW); in 18.40 a being, not the guṇa
why.नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः: 18.28: Śaṅkara's reading (paravṛtticchedanapara, cutting off others' livelihood), which our meaning follows, beside the dictionaries' 'dishonest'
why.परिग्रहम्: parigraha 'acquisition, possession, property' (MW); Śaṅkara outward possessions; possessiveness is nirmamaḥ
